examples.label: Invoice rows inside a billing table
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-table" site="Global" id="table-invoices" padding="small" rows_border="extra_small">
  <:header>Invoice</:header>
  <:header>Issued</:header>
  <:header>Amount</:header>
  <:header>Status</:header>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-tr" site="Global">
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global" class="font-medium">INV-2041</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">1 Mar 2026</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">$249.00</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">
      <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" variant="default" color="success" rounded="full">Paid</.component>
    </.component>
  </.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-tr" site="Global">
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global" class="font-medium">INV-2042</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">1 Apr 2026</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">$249.00</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">
      <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" variant="default" color="warning" rounded="full">Due in 9 days</.component>
    </.component>
  </.component>
</.component>

examples.label: Highlighted row in a team members table
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-table" site="Global" id="table-team-members" padding="small" rows_border="extra_small">
  <:header>Name</:header>
  <:header>Email</:header>
  <:header>Role</:header>
  <:header>Last activity</:header>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-tr" site="Global">
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global" class="font-medium">Emily Carter</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">emily@example.com</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">Editor</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">Active two hours ago</.component>
  </.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-tr" site="Global" class="bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/10">
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global" class="font-medium">Noah Bennett</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">noah@example.com</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">Invited</.component>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-td" site="Global">Invitation expires tomorrow</.component>
  </.component>
</.component>
